title: A Target-Centric Survey of Quantization-Aware Training
abstract: arXiv:2608.29667v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The rapid development of LLMs incurs prohibitive memory footprints and intensive computational demands. Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) techniques have emerged as a promising solution to address these challenges by explicitly simulating quantization effects during model training, yielding low-bit models that achieve accuracy comparable to their full-precision counterparts. In this work, we provide a target-centric survey of QAT, aimed at clarifying both its theoretical foundations and its evolving implementation landscape. We systematically review existing QAT methods through a target-centric taxonomy and synthesize cross-target differences in error characteristics, numerical formats, and strategy transferability. We further summarize QAT evaluation paradigms and discuss challenges in optimization and deployment, outlining potential directions for future research.

translated_title: 以目标为中心的量化感知训练综述
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展带来了高昂的内存占用和密集的计算需求。量化感知训练技术通过在模型训练过程中显式模拟量化效应，成为应对这些挑战的一种有前景的解决方案，能够产生精度可与全精度模型相媲美的低比特模型。在这项工作中，我们提供了一篇以目标为中心的QAT综述，旨在阐明其理论基础与不断发展的实现图景。我们通过以目标为中心的分类体系系统地回顾了现有的QAT方法，并综合分析了不同目标之间在误差特性、数值格式和策略可迁移性方面的差异。我们进一步总结了QAT的评估范式，讨论了优化与部署中的挑战，并概述了未来研究的潜在方向。
tldr: 本文是一篇以目标为中心的量化感知训练（QAT）综述，通过目标导向的分类体系系统梳理了现有方法、跨目标的误差特性与策略差异、评估范式以及优化部署挑战与未来研究方向。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a target-centric survey of Quantization-Aware Training (QAT), systematically reviewing existing methods through a target-centric taxonomy, synthesizing cross-target differences in error characteristics and strategy transferability, and outlining evaluation paradigms, deployment challenges, and future research directions.
